releaseTitle: MusicDeck v3.0.13 - Headphone Crossfeed (Bauer DSP), Wallpaper Palette & EQ Preset Sharing
releaseNotes: Introduces audiophile-grade Bauer Binaural Crossfeed (BS2B) native C++ DSP for natural studio soundstage on headphones, universal Wallpaper Match dynamic theming via AndroidX Palette, EQ Preset export & community sharing (.deck files), intelligent Smart Playlist scoring with custom vector icons, Car Mode dashboard refinements with 1-tap Favorites, and Pocket-safe shake protection.
